scope.hint: Every number counts only tours in this period, group type and place. Leave the dates empty for all time.

descriptions.sessionsAttended: Confirmed sessions on completed tours, less tours the buddy was recorded absent from. One tour can have several sessions.
descriptions.toursAttended: Tours with at least one session attended. Several sessions on the same tour count once.
descriptions.attendanceRate: Tours attended ÷ (tours attended + tours missed). A no-show or a late cancellation counts as missed, once per tour.
descriptions.openMaybe: Bookings on upcoming tours still at Maybe: not yet confirmed or cancelled.
descriptions.hoursOnTour: Start-to-end time of the sessions attended. Tour time, not working hours. Sessions without times are left out, so this can undercount.
descriptions.sessionsWithoutTimes: Sessions attended with no start or end time, so they are not counted in hours on tour.
descriptions.lateCancellations: Cancellations made on or after the cancellation deadline: the buddy's own deadline if set, otherwise the tour's.
descriptions.cancellationRate: Cancellations ÷ bookings. Bookings counts every booking, whatever its status.
descriptions.cancellationsUnavoidable: Cancellations an admin reviewed and marked unavoidable.
descriptions.cancellationsAvoidable: Cancellations an admin reviewed and marked avoidable.
descriptions.cancellationsUnreviewed: Cancellations whose reason no admin has reviewed yet.
descriptions.evaluationsMissing: Tours attended that have no admin evaluation yet.
descriptions.moments: Moments recorded in the buddy's reflections.
descriptions.averageScore: Mean over each evaluation that scored this criterion, on a 1–5 scale. Evaluations that left it blank are not counted.
